findings.title: Empty AI turn drops user's question too
findings.problem: In concise mode (include_tool_outputs=false), _add_message_pair_to_document skips the pair whenever ai_message.message is empty, even when the pair carried no thoughts at all - i.e. the assistant produced no text for reasons unrelated to concise-mode thought stripping.
findings.impact: The user's own question for that turn is also silently dropped from the export with no indication anything was omitted. Whether the spec's 'skip pairs whose message is empty once thoughts are dropped' should apply only when thoughts existed (content moved there) versus any empty final message is a product-intent question, not a code question.
findings.recommendation: Confirm with the story owner whether the skip at message_exporter.py:399 should be scoped to ai_message.thoughts being non-empty, or intentionally applies to any empty final message regardless of thoughts; adjust the guard accordingly.

findings.title: All-filtered concise export returns blank document
findings.problem: When every message pair in a conversation is skipped in concise mode (all ai_message.message values empty), build_conversation_document (message_exporter.py:369-380) still returns a Document containing only the title heading, and _export_full_conversation (message_exporter.py:668-683) exports it as-is.
findings.impact: The caller receives a successful 200 OK DOCX/PDF response that is functionally blank, with no signal distinguishing 'content was filtered out' from 'the conversation is actually empty'.
findings.recommendation: After the message-pair loop, check whether any pair content was added; if not, add a single explanatory paragraph (e.g. 'No content to export in concise mode.') before returning the document.

findings.title: Code-block rendering untested for concise/full DOCX export
findings.problem: Neither test_export_concise_mode_omits_thought_content_end_to_end nor test_export_full_mode_keeps_thought_content_end_to_end exercises a message containing a fenced code block through the new concise/full DOCX export path; the only existing code-block tests (test_message_exporter.py:195-219) cover thought-content markdown parsing, not this path.
findings.impact: A regression in code-block rendering introduced anywhere along the new gating logic would ship undetected, and the story's explicit code-block-rendering AC for DOCX stays unverified.
findings.recommendation: Add an end-to-end assertion (concise and full) with a message containing a fenced code block and assert the produced DOCX renders it as a code-block run.

findings.title: Explicit include_tool_outputs=false lacks real-pipeline content test
findings.problem: The explicit include_tool_outputs=false case is exercised only via the mocked-wiring test (test_export_concise_mode_omits_thoughts); unlike the omitted-default and true cases, there is no real-pipeline end-to-end test asserting thought-content absence when false is passed explicitly on the query string.
findings.impact: A behavioral divergence between 'omitted' and 'explicit false' (e.g. a default-handling bug in the router) would not be caught by the current suite.
findings.recommendation: Add an end-to-end test mirroring test_export_concise_mode_omits_thought_content_end_to_end that passes include_tool_outputs=false explicitly on the query string and asserts identical thought-absent output.

findings.title: Lists/tables/links formatting untested post-filter
findings.problem: The diff's end-to-end tests use plain-text messages only ('Explain X' / 'Here is the explanation.'); no test exercises a surviving message containing lists, tables, or links in either concise or full mode.
findings.impact: The AC that 'headings, lists, tables, links already present in surviving content continue to render correctly' rests on 'formatting is unaffected by this change' reasoning rather than direct test evidence.
findings.recommendation: Add a fixture message with a list, a table, and a link, and assert correct DOCX/PDF rendering survives the concise-mode filtering path.
